description: The stock arm of the add-function pair: the same goal on Claude Code with nothing installed, replayed from a committed cassette.
why: Program H10: the same seed and goal with and without PAN, paired, is how the product's value claim gets measured. At tier 0 the pair replays synthetic cassettes, which proves the plumbing (both arms run, the report pairs them and gives deltas with intervals); the evidence run re-records both arms from a real model with paired reps.

pair.goal: Add an add(a, b) function to math.js

steps.prompt: Add an add(a, b) function to math.js
steps.why: The session reaches the goal: math.js exists. The cassette answers every request at $0; `--record` re-records it from the synthetic recipe.

controls.why: With Bash denied the session cannot write math.js: a scenario that still passed would not be measuring the goal.
